decisions.reason: The confirmed values price the Basic package by square-footage tier; they do not change the separate requirement to display transparent, itemized prices for individual services.
The source confirms a Basic package pricing matrix for presentation but does not state that the deferred calculator must adopt these values or alter its bundle-qualification and calculation logic.
Changing the Basic package's tier prices does not alter the one-time pricing model or the requirement to hide monthly and annual pricing tabs.
The confirmed package prices do not change the existence, placement, or destination behavior of the detailed-pricing navigation entry.
The package pricing decision is unrelated to the homepage design direction, image emphasis, or blue overlay treatment.
The confirmed pricing matrix does not change the homepage gallery animation requirement.
The source decision does not affect gallery scrolling, tab organization, or secondary gallery content.
The Basic package price confirmation has no effect on whether gallery hover animations are enabled.
The package pricing values do not modify the sitewide requirement for highly visual, image-focused presentation.
The confirmed Basic package pricing tiers do not change the requirement to associate each listed service with a relevant image.
